me.title: Engineering Manager
focus: Speak in business impact, not technical detail
Listen and learn before proposing solutions

entries.text:
First week listening tour

Met with eight people this week. Common theme: integrations break quietly and nobody owns the fix end to end. Resist the urge to propose solutions before the 30-day mark.

Budget 1:1 with the CFO

Dana wants a one-page view of integration spend before Q1 planning. She prefers numbers first, story second. I committed to sending a draft by October 10.

Own the HR system sync failures

Payroll-to-HR sync failed twice this month. Decided my team takes ownership of monitoring and alerting; Priya will draft the runbook. Marcus asked for a weekly status note until it's stable.

Lunch-and-learn - intro to MCP

Demoed this journal server. The moment that landed: Claude chaining a search and a get without being told to. Question that came up: how does the server know who I am? Good lead-in for the auth session.
